digest.component_or_area: code-review criterion / CI gate compatibility verifier
propositions: New hard-fail CI gates break branches created before the gate was added because code-review criteria have no mechanism to check backward compatibility
A new advisory project criterion should ask whether a pipeline/gate-configuration change introduces a hard-fail step with no grandfather guard that would fail pre-existing branches

Project code-review criteria must be gated by declarative applies_to globs matching changed files, supporting multiple CI vendors (.github/workflows, Jenkinsfile, .gitlab-ci.yml, .circleci, azure-pipelines, .buildkite, bitbucket-pipelines, .drone) without hard-coding vendor names in shipped code
The glob set must be project-overridable via a [code_review] ci_config_globs config key so unusual pipelines are declared rather than enumerated by the framework
